source.statement:
SELECT
  f.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_ID,
  f.ORDER_LINE AS ORDER_LINE,
  f.CUSTOMER_KEY AS CUSTOMER_KEY,
  f.PRODUCT_KEY AS PRODUCT_KEY,
  f.PROMO_KEY AS PROMO_KEY,
  f.ORDER_STORE_KEY AS STORE_KEY,
  f.ORDER_DATE_KEY AS DATE_KEY,
  f.ORDER_CHANNEL AS ORDER_CHANNEL,
  f.SHIP_METHOD AS SHIP_METHOD,
  f.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS,
  f.QUANTITY_ORDERED AS QUANTITY_ORDERED,
  f.QUANTITY_RETURNED AS QUANTITY_RETURNED,
  f.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE,
  f.UNIT_COST AS UNIT_COST,
  f.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,
  f.SHIPPING_AMOUNT AS SHIPPING_AMOUNT,
  f.TAX_AMOUNT AS TAX_AMOUNT,
  f.GROSS_REVENUE AS GROSS_REVENUE,
  f.NET_REVENUE AS NET_REVENUE,
  f.GROSS_PROFIT AS GROSS_PROFIT,
  f.NET_PROFIT AS NET_PROFIT,
  f.IS_FIRST_ORDER AS IS_FIRST_ORDER,
  f.IS_RETURNED AS IS_RETURNED,
  f.IS_CANCELLED AS IS_CANCELLED,
  f.DAYS_TO_SHIP AS DAYS_TO_SHIP,
  a.CUSTOMER_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID,
  a.FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME,
  a.LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME,
  a.CITY AS CUSTOMER_CITY,
  a.STATE AS CUSTOMER_STATE,
  a.REGION AS CUSTOMER_REGION,
  a.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT AS CUSTOMER_SEGMENT,
  a.LOYALTY_TIER AS LOYALTY_TIER,
  a.ACQUISITION_CHANNEL AS ACQUISITION_CHANNEL,
  a.LIFETIME_REVENUE AS LIFETIME_REVENUE,
  b.PRODUCT_ID AS PRODUCT_ID,
  b.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME,
  b.CATEGORY AS CATEGORY,
  b.SUBCATEGORY AS SUBCATEGORY,
  b.BRAND AS BRAND,
  b.IS_PRIVATE_LABEL AS IS_PRIVATE_LABEL,
  b.IS_SEASONAL AS IS_SEASONAL,
  c.STORE_ID AS STORE_ID,
  c.STORE_NAME AS STORE_NAME,
  c.STORE_TYPE AS STORE_TYPE,
  c.CITY AS STORE_CITY,
  c.STATE AS STORE_STATE,
  c.REGION AS STORE_REGION,
  c.DISTRICT AS DISTRICT,
  c.MANAGER_NAME AS MANAGER_NAME,
  d.FULL_DATE AS FULL_DATE,
  d.DAY_OF_WEEK AS DAY_OF_WEEK,
  d.MONTH_NUMBER AS MONTH_NUMBER,
  d.MONTH_NAME AS MONTH_NAME,
  d.QUARTER AS QUARTER,
  d.YEAR AS YEAR,
  d.IS_WEEKEND AS IS_WEEKEND,
  d.IS_HOLIDAY AS IS_HOLIDAY,
  e.PROMO_NAME AS PROMO_NAME,
  e.PROMO_TYPE AS PROMO_TYPE,
  e.CHANNEL AS PROMO_CHANNEL,
  e.DISCOUNT_PCT AS DISCOUNT_PCT,
  e.TARGET_SEGMENT AS TARGET_SEGMENT
FROM CSA.TJ.ORDER_FACT f
LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.CUSTOMER_DIM a ON f.CUSTOMER_KEY = a.CUSTOMER_KEY
LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.PRODUCT_DIM b ON f.PRODUCT_KEY = b.PRODUCT_KEY
LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.STORE_DIM c ON f.ORDER_STORE_KEY = c.STORE_KEY
LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.DATE_DIM d ON f.ORDER_DATE_KEY = d.DATE_KEY
LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.PROMO_DIM e ON f.PROMO_KEY = e.PROMO_KEY
